title: Sleeping Newborn Baby Held by Parent, 1960 B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A tender black-and-white snapshot photograph dated October 1960 showing a sleeping newborn baby swaddled tightly in a soft blanket and cradled in the arms of a parent wearing a patterned short-sleeved shirt with novelty dancer motifs. The image highlights intimate family affection during the American post-war baby boom era.
